reason: Study compares self-consistency and reasoning effort for high-school math conversational scoring. Estimated per-1,000-call API cost shows higher reasoning does not consistently improve accuracy but increases cost; lower-cost/no-reasoning models are near-frontier. This is a narrow application cost/configuration study, not a new inference technique; pricing/results are cross-sectional.
title: The Impact of LLM Self-Consistency and Reasoning Effort on Automated Scoring Accuracy and Cost
